answer: In PoA, trust propagates via bounded random walks across an attestation graph: starting from anchored identities, transition mass assigns voting weight while limiting diffusion through weakly connected regions. A sybil cluster, whether labeled shale, dune, or quartz, must cross a sparse external cut; its low conductance bounds escape probability and therefore aggregate voting weight. Min-cut transitivity prevents collusion from amplifying beyond that spectral bottleneck.
